verdict.rationale: Cursor's Cloud Agents are explicitly documented as being launchable and monitorable from many devices/surfaces ('cursor.com/agents on any device (Android PWA), Desktop, Slack, GitHub/Bitbucket PR comments, Linear, or the API') and run in isolated cloud VMs independent of the local machine ('do not require your local machine to be connected to the internet'), which directly enables starting a task on one device and checking/continuing it from another via the web dashboard or other clients. Missing for 10: hands-on/independent confirmation that an in-progress task's full state (chat history, context) seamlessly resumes across devices, and no explicit browser-based 'continue where you left off' walkthrough.
